Keeps IREE's chosen pipeline (CPUDoubleTilingExpert / CPUConvTileAndDecomposeExpert / CPUBufferOpsTileAndVectorize) and only overrides the root linalg op's lowering_config<tile_sizes = [...]>. 先平行探索：找出 L2C 相關程式碼實際落在哪裡。

input.command: echo "=== repo root dirs ===" && ls -la && echo "=== does verilator/ exist? ===" && ls -d verilator/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NO verilator/ dir" && echo "=== grep -ril l2c across repo (excluding .git, PDFs) ===" && grep -ril "l2c" --include="*.c" --include="*.h" --include="*.hpp" --include="*.cpp" --include="*.cc" --include="*.sh" --include="*.md" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -60

1	// Wire contract between the QEMU TCG plugin and vsim. Both sides write/read
2	// `struct hybrid_state_v1` byte-for-byte through a shared file.
3	//
4	// Stability: never repurpose offsets within a published version. Add new
5	// fields by consuming bytes from `reserved`, or by introducing v2 alongside.
6	//
7	// Endianness: multi-byte fields are little-endian (native on RV64 + x86-64
8	// host). The format is not endian-portable; cross-endian use would need an
9	// explicit byte-swap path.
10	//
11	// C and C++ both compile this header.
12	
13	#ifndef HYBRID_STATE_ABI_H
14	#define HYBRID_STATE_ABI_H
15	
16	#include <stdint.h>
17	#include <stddef.h>
18	
19	#ifdef __cplusplus
20	extern "C" {
21	#endif
22	
23	#define HYBRID_STATE_MAGIC   0x42594841u  // 'AHYB' little-endian
24	// Version 6 (write-mask): append uint64_t write_mask[2] after the L2C block
25	// (carved from reserved, total size unchanged) -- one bit per mask-governed
26	// config CSR recording whether the producer's guest actually WROTE it (slot
27	// map + decode helpers in hybrid/write_mask.h, gated by
28	// HYBRID_FLAG_WRITE_MASK). Consumers restore/verify an untouched CSR's
29	// drained value no longer: it is only the producer's reset default, which can
30	// legitimately differ from the consuming engine's RTL reset value.
31	// Version 5 (L2C): append struct hybrid_l2c after the M-ext block -- the L2
32	// cache controller Control Register (MMIO @ L2C base + 0x0008: CEN enable +
33	// prefetch/ECC/RAM-timing config, DS220 11.8.7). Unlike every prior block this
34	// is DEVICE MMIO, not a CSR: the plugin drains it with a physical-address memory
35	// read and vsim restores it with a Program-Buffer store, both capability-gated
36	// on the engine actually having an L2C. Transported forward-looking (current
37	// engines are built without an L2C -> flag stays clear -> whole block skipped).
38	// Version 4 (M-ext): append struct hybrid_m_ext_csr after the Andes block --
39	// the writable M-mode CSRs across the whole AndeStar V5 SPA (NMI, CLIC, perf
40	// counters, trap-save, triggers, state-enable, ...), transported forward-looking
41	// and capability-gated per engine. Version 3 (Andes F0) appended
42	// struct hybrid_andes_csr after mmisc_ctl. Version 2 (L11) widened vreg[] to
43	// 128 bytes/register. Readers reject older files loudly (all three consumers
44	// check magic + version + size) instead of mis-parsing them.
45	#define HYBRID_STATE_VERSION 6u
46	
47	#define HYBRID_FLAG_RV64  (1u << 0)
48	#define HYBRID_FLAG_FP    (1u << 1)
49	#define HYBRID_FLAG_V     (1u << 2)
50	// v3: the struct hybrid_andes_csr block carries live values (the producer ran
51	// on an Andes core that implements at least one of those CSRs). Clear means the
52	// block is all-zero and consumers skip restore/re-read/compare of it.
53	#define HYBRID_FLAG_ANDES (1u << 3)
54	// v4: the struct hybrid_m_ext_csr block carries live values (the producer's
55	// gdbstub advertised at least one of those CSRs). Clear means the block is
56	// all-zero and consumers skip restore/re-read/compare of it.
57	#define HYBRID_FLAG_M_EXT (1u << 4)
58	// v5: the struct hybrid_l2c block carries live values (the producer could read
59	// the L2C MMIO region). Clear means the block is all-zero and consumers skip
60	// restore/re-read/compare of it -- the case on every engine built without an L2C.
61	#define HYBRID_FLAG_L2C   (1u << 5)
62	// v6: write_mask[] is live (the producer tracked guest CSR writes). Clear
63	// means no write information -- consumers fall back to restore-everything,
64	// the pre-v6 behavior. See hybrid/write_mask.h for the slot map and policy.
65	#define HYBRID_FLAG_WRITE_MASK (1u << 6)
66	
67	// VLEN upper bound, in bytes: 128 covers the supported engine range
68	// VLEN 128..1024 (L11; also QEMU's RV_VLEN_MAX). This is the wire-format
69	// span per vector register; the LIVE width is the runtime `vlenb` field
70	// below, so one struct layout serves every engine config and the legs
71	// never disagree on offsets. A producer whose vlenb exceeds this ceiling
72	// must refuse to drain (see hybrid_v_drain_policy) rather than truncate.
73	#define HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX 128
74	
75	// L26: bytes reserved for the V-register transport scratch page -- 32 vector
76	// registers at the wire-format span. The driver maps this many bytes ABOVE
77	// the program's --mem-size (so the scratch sits past the program's RAM), and
78	// vsim's v_scratch_gpa() / kVScratchBytes use the same count. Shared here so
79	// the producer (driver mmap sizing) and consumer (vsim sweep) never disagree.
80	#define HYBRID_V_SCRATCH_BYTES (32 * HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX)
81	
82	// 64 PMP entries; pmpcfg slots reserved at 16 so the layout works for both
83	// RV64 (8 entries/CSR) and a future RV32 (4 entries/CSR) packing.
84	#define HYBRID_PMP_CFG_NUM  16
85	#define HYBRID_PMP_ADDR_NUM 64
86	
87	// v3 Andes CSR block. PMA is 16 entries: pmacfg packs them at one byte each, so
88	// on RV64 only the even-numbered cfg CSRs exist -- 16 entries live in pmacfg0
89	// (0xBC0) + pmacfg2 (0xBC2), hence 2 cfg slots; 16 pmaaddr (0xBD0..0xBDF).
90	#define HYBRID_PMA_CFG_NUM  2
91	#define HYBRID_PMA_ADDR_NUM 16
92	#define HYBRID_PMA_CFG0_CSR   0xBC0
93	#define HYBRID_PMA_ADDR0_CSR  0xBD0
94	
95	// Single source of truth for the SCALAR Andes CSRs transported in v3: X(field,
96	// csr_addr, gdb_name). Every consumer (QEMU plugin drain, ResumeDriver restore,
97	// StateDrain re-read, driver state_diff verify) iterates this list, so adding a
98	// CSR is one line here -- no consumer edits drift out of sync. PMA (arrays) is
99	// transported separately, mirroring the existing PMP loops. Each field is a
100	// 64-bit CSR value; 0 means the producing engine did not implement it (a
101	// tolerant no-op on restore). Order fixes the struct layout -- append only.
102	#define HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST(X)            \
103	  X(mxstatus,       0x7C4, "mxstatus")      \
104	  X(mpft_ctl,       0x7C5, "mpft_ctl")      \
105	  X(mclk_ctl,       0x7DF, "mclk_ctl")      \
106	  X(milmb,          0x7C0, "milmb")         \
107	  X(mdlmb,          0x7C1, "mdlmb")         \
108	  X(mecc_code,      0x7C2, "mecc_code")     \
109	  X(mhsp_ctl,       0x7C6, "mhsp_ctl")      \
110	  X(msp_bound,      0x7C7, "msp_bound")     \
111	  X(msp_base,       0x7C8, "msp_base")      \
112	  X(mcountermask_m, 0x7D1, "mcountermask_m")\
113	  X(uitb,           0x800, "uitb")          \
114	  X(jvt,            0x017, "jvt")           \
115	  X(ucode,          0x801, "ucode")
116	
117	// The Andes V5 machine/user CSRs a bare-metal Andes core sets up before the ROI
118	// (boot-static memory system + extension config) plus the DSP overflow flag.
119	// Restored at resume, re-read at drain, and verified -- live only when
120	// HYBRID_FLAG_ANDES is set. 13 scalar fields (above) + PMA = 31 * uint64_t.
121	struct hybrid_andes_csr {
122	#define HYBRID_ANDES_FIELD(field, addr, name) uint64_t field;
123	  HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST(HYBRID_ANDES_FIELD)
124	#undef HYBRID_ANDES_FIELD
125	  uint64_t pmacfg[HYBRID_PMA_CFG_NUM];
126	  uint64_t pmaaddr[HYBRID_PMA_ADDR_NUM];
127	};

129	// v4: the writable M-mode CSRs across the whole AndeStar V5 SPA that a
130	// bare-metal M / M+U ROI can hold as plain architectural state -- everything
131	// the spec defines as readable+writable with no read/write side effects, minus
132	// the blocks already carried above (standard M trap CSRs, the v3 Andes block,
133	// PMP, PMA, FP, V). Same single-source-of-truth X-macro pattern as
134	// HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST: X(field, csr_addr, gdb_name). Every consumer (plugin
135	// drain, ResumeDriver restore, StateDrain re-read, driver state_diff verify)
136	// iterates this list, so adding a CSR is one line. Each is capability-gated by
137	// CSR address (src/hybrid/andes_caps.hpp): an engine that lacks the feature
138	// no-ops the restore/drain, so the block is transported forward-looking -- a
139	// core that implements it (CLIC, Smrnmi, Smstateen, ePMP, ...) round-trips it
140	// with no further change. Order fixes the struct layout -- append only.
141	#define HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST(X)                \
142	  X(menvcfg,         0x30A, "menvcfg")          \
143	  X(mseccfg,         0x747, "mseccfg")          \
144	  X(mcounteren,      0x306, "mcounteren")       \
145	  X(mcountinhibit,   0x320, "mcountinhibit")    \
146	  X(mhpmcounter3,    0xB03, "mhpmcounter3")     \
147	  X(mhpmcounter4,    0xB04, "mhpmcounter4")     \
148	  X(mhpmcounter5,    0xB05, "mhpmcounter5")     \
149	  X(mhpmcounter6,    0xB06, "mhpmcounter6")     \
150	  X(mhpmevent3,      0x323, "mhpmevent3")       \
151	  X(mhpmevent4,      0x324, "mhpmevent4")       \
152	  X(mhpmevent5,      0x325, "mhpmevent5")       \
153	  X(mhpmevent6,      0x326, "mhpmevent6")       \
154	  X(mcounterwen,     0x7CE, "mcounterwen")      \
155	  X(mcounterinten,   0x7CF, "mcounterinten")    \
156	  X(mcountermask_s,  0x7D2, "mcountermask_s")   \
157	  X(mcountermask_u,  0x7D3, "mcountermask_u")   \
158	  X(mnscratch,       0x740, "mnscratch")        \
159	  X(mnepc,           0x741, "mnepc")            \

163	  X(mrnxvec,         0x7DE, "mrnxvec")          \
164	  X(mdcause,         0x7C9, "mdcause")          \

194	// Number of CSRs in HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST (locks the struct size in the checks).
195	#define HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_NUM 51
196	
197	struct hybrid_m_ext_csr {
198	#define HYBRID_M_EXT_FIELD(field, addr, name) uint64_t field;
199	  HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST(HYBRID_M_EXT_FIELD)
200	#undef HYBRID_M_EXT_FIELD
201	};
202	
203	// v5: L2 cache controller (L2C) MMIO register block. Memory-mapped at L2C base
204	// 0xE0500000 (DS220 24.2). The documented register window spans offset
205	// 0x0000..0x0527 (DS220 11.8.5 Table 112, Number of Processor Cores 1-4). The
206	// WHOLE window is captured verbatim (little-endian, native RV64/x86-64) so the
207	// drained record is complete and --verify-able; `reg[off/8]` is the 64-bit
208	// register at byte offset `off`. Live only when HYBRID_FLAG_L2C is set.
209	//
210	// On resume, ResumeDriver writes back ONLY the boot-static WRITABLE config
211	// registers listed below. Everything else in the window is captured but never
212	// restored, because writing it is wrong or unsafe:
213	//   - Configuration Register (0x0000): read-only, derived from the build.
214	//   - CCTL Command Registers (0x0040..0x007f): writing one RE-ISSUES an L2 cache
215	//     flush/invalidate -- restoring a stale command would kick off a cache op at
216	//     ROI entry.
217	//   - Asynchronous/Error Registers (0x0030..0x003f): write-1-clear status.
218	//   - CCTL Status (0x0080), HPM Counters (0x0200..0x020f): read-only / volatile.
219	#define HYBRID_L2C_REG_WINDOW_BYTES  0x528u              /* 0x0000..0x0527 */
220	#define HYBRID_L2C_REG_WINDOW_QWORDS (0x528u / 8u)       /* 165 * uint64_t = 1320 B */
221	
222	// Writable boot-static config register offsets restored on resume (DS220 11.8.7 /
223	// 11.8.8 / 11.8.17). Each is a 64-bit register the hart accesses 4 bytes at a time
224	// (DS220 11.8.3: single transfer, access size < 8 bytes, device non-bufferable).
225	#define HYBRID_L2C_OFF_CONTROL   0x0008u  /* CEN enable + PFTHRES + ECCEN + RAM timing */
226	#define HYBRID_L2C_OFF_HPM_CTL0  0x0010u  /* HPM Control Register 0 (event select) */
227	#define HYBRID_L2C_OFF_WAYMASK0  0x0300u  /* Way Allocation Mask Register 0 */
228	#define HYBRID_L2C_WAYMASK_NUM   5u       /* masks 0..4 @ 0x0300,0x0308,..,0x0320 (cores 1-4) */

230	struct hybrid_l2c {
231	  uint64_t reg[HYBRID_L2C_REG_WINDOW_QWORDS];  // reg[off/8] = register @ byte offset off
232	};

235	// unnecessary and would force unaligned access codegen. Layout is locked by
236	// the static_asserts in state_abi_check.h.

238	  uint32_t magic;
239	  uint32_t version;
240	  uint32_t flags;
241	  uint32_t hart_id;
242	  uint64_t pc;
243	  uint64_t priv;  // 0=U, 1=S, 3=M
244	
245	  uint64_t gpr[32];
246	  uint64_t fpr[32];
247	
248	  uint64_t mstatus;
249	  uint64_t mepc;
250	  uint64_t mtvec;
251	  uint64_t mcause;
252	  uint64_t mtval;
253	  uint64_t mscratch;
254	  uint64_t medeleg;
255	  uint64_t mideleg;
256	  uint64_t mip;
257	  uint64_t mie;
258	  uint64_t mcycle;
259	  uint64_t minstret;
260	  uint64_t satp;
261	
262	  uint64_t pmpcfg[HYBRID_PMP_CFG_NUM];
263	  uint64_t pmpaddr[HYBRID_PMP_ADDR_NUM];
264	
265	  uint64_t vstart;
266	  uint64_t vtype;
267	  uint64_t vl;
268	  uint64_t vlenb;
269	  uint8_t  vreg[32 * HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX];
270	  uint64_t vxsat;
271	  uint64_t vxrm;
272	  uint64_t vcsr;
273	
274	  // L20: FP control/status -- frm[7:5] | fflags[4:0], live when
275	  // HYBRID_FLAG_FP is set. Drained by the plugin, restored by ResumeDriver,
276	  // re-read by StateDrain. Pre-L20 state files carry 0 here (reserved bytes
277	  // are written as zero), which reads back as the reset value (RNE, no
278	  // flags) -- exactly the old behavior, so no version bump.
279	  uint64_t fcsr;
280	
281	  // Andes machine-setup CSRs: mcache_ctl (0x7CA) enables the L1 I/D caches,
282	  // mmisc_ctl (0x7D0) holds misc machine config. crt0 writes them once at
283	  // boot; transporting them keeps the cycle engine from resuming caches-off
284	  // (ResumeDriver has the full rationale). Drained by the plugin, restored by
285	  // ResumeDriver, but NOT re-read by StateDrain: they are boot-static and the
286	  // drained value is unused (no QEMU2 leg). Old state files carry 0 here
287	  // (reset value), which is the pre-existing behavior, so no version bump.
288	  uint64_t mcache_ctl;
289	  uint64_t mmisc_ctl;
290	
291	  // v3: Andes V5 CSR block (live when HYBRID_FLAG_ANDES). 31 * 8 = 248 bytes.
292	  struct hybrid_andes_csr andes;
293	
294	  // v4: writable M-mode CSR block (live when HYBRID_FLAG_M_EXT). 51 * 8 = 408
295	  // bytes. Capability-gated per engine; transported forward-looking.
296	  struct hybrid_m_ext_csr m_ext;
297	
298	  // v5: L2C MMIO register window (live when HYBRID_FLAG_L2C). 165 * 8 = 1320
299	  // bytes. Capability-gated on the engine having an L2C; transported
300	  // forward-looking. Whole window captured; only writable config restored.
301	  struct hybrid_l2c l2c;
302	
303	  // v6: one bit per mask-governed config CSR -- set when the producer's guest
304	  // actually WROTE it (live when HYBRID_FLAG_WRITE_MASK). Slot numbering is
305	  // wire format, defined in hybrid/write_mask.h from the same X-macros that
306	  // fix the block layouts above. Carved from reserved: total size unchanged.
307	  uint64_t write_mask[2];
308	
309	  uint8_t  reserved[48];  // zero-initialise on write; v6-compatible growth room
310	};

313	}  // extern "C"
314	#endif
315

317	#include "hybrid/write_mask.h"
318	
319	#endif  // HYBRID_STATE_ABI_H

===== test_plugin_l2c_drain.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# v5 contract: the QEMU plugin drains the L2C MMIO register window into
# hybrid_state_v1. The l2c_drain fixture writes 0xA5 to the L2C Control Register
# (0xE0500008) and then hits the ROI entry marker; the plugin must set
# HYBRID_FLAG_L2C and capture 0xA5 at hybrid_l2c.reg[HYBRID_L2C_OFF_CONTROL/8].
#
# Required environment (auto-detected with sensible defaults):
#   VSIM_QEMU    qemu-system-riscv64
#   VSIM_PLUGIN  libhybrid_handoff.so
#   VSIM_ELF     the l2c_drain fixture (FIXTURE=l2c_drain)

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-l2c_drain}"
hybrid_resolve_paths

REPO_ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-plugin-l2c-shared.XXXXXX)
STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
QEMU_LOG=$(mktemp)
CHECK_SRC=$(mktemp --suffix=.c)
CHECK_BIN=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU" "$QEMU_LOG" "$CHECK_SRC" "$CHECK_BIN"' EXIT
truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"

set +e
"$VSIM_QEMU" \
  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
  -nographic \
  -semihosting-config enable=on,target=native \
  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,outfile=$STATE_QEMU" >"$QEMU_LOG" 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e

if [ "$RC" -ne 200 ]; then
  echo "FAIL[plugin_l2c_drain]: expected QEMU exit=200 on drain, got $RC"
  echo "--- qemu log ---"; cat "$QEMU_LOG"
  exit 1
fi

# Inspect the drained struct via a tiny C checker that shares the ABI header,
# so the field offset stays robust to layout changes.
cat > "$CHECK_SRC" <<'EOF'
#include "hybrid/state_abi.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!f) { fprintf(stderr, "open %s failed\n", argv[1]); return 2; }
    struct hybrid_state_v1 s;
    size_t n = fread(&s, 1, sizeof(s), f);
    fclose(f);
    if (n != sizeof(s)) { fprintf(stderr, "short read %zu != %zu\n", n, sizeof(s)); return 3; }
    if (s.magic != HYBRID_STATE_MAGIC) { fprintf(stderr, "bad magic\n"); return 4; }
    if (!(s.flags & HYBRID_FLAG_L2C)) { fprintf(stderr, "HYBRID_FLAG_L2C not set\n"); return 5; }
    unsigned long long ctrl = (unsigned long long) s.l2c.reg[HYBRID_L2C_OFF_CONTROL / 8];
    unsigned long long want = strtoull(argv[2], NULL, 0);
    if (ctrl != want) { fprintf(stderr, "l2c ctrl=0x%llx want=0x%llx\n", ctrl, want); return 6; }
    printf("OK: HYBRID_FLAG_L2C set, l2c.ctrl=0x%llx\n", ctrl);
    return 0;
}
EOF
cc -std=c11 -I "$REPO_ROOT/include" "$CHECK_SRC" -o "$CHECK_BIN"

if "$CHECK_BIN" "$STATE_QEMU" 0xA5; then
  echo "PASS[plugin_l2c_drain]"
else
  echo "FAIL[plugin_l2c_drain]: L2C register window not drained correctly"
  exit 1
fi

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!f) return 2;
    struct hybrid_state_v1 s;

    unsigned long long ctrl = (unsigned long long) s.l2c.reg[HYBRID_L2C_OFF_CONTROL / 8];
    if ((ctrl & 0x1u) != 0x1u) { fprintf(stderr, "CEN not set: l2c.ctrl=0x%llx\n", ctrl); return 6; }
    printf("OK: reset default CEN=1, l2c.ctrl=0x%llx\n", ctrl);
    return 0;
}
EOF
cc -std=c11 -I "$REPO_ROOT/include" "$CHECK_SRC" -o "$CHECK_BIN"

if "$CHECK_BIN" "$STATE_QEMU"; then
  echo "PASS[plugin_l2c_reset_default]"
else
  echo "FAIL[plugin_l2c_reset_default]: L2C reset default CEN=1 not observed"
  exit 1
fi

content.text:
讀完四條腿的實際程式碼 + QEMU model + engine config + 測試，結論如下。

## 一句話結論

L2C（0xE0500000）的 state transport **已經全部實作完成**，但現在是**休眠狀態（built but dormant）**：現有 engine 都沒有 L2C，所以 vsim 側完全 no-op；QEMU 側只是一個 RAM stub，不是真的 cache model。所以「能不能正確轉移」要分兩層看 - 機制蓋好了，但真正的 round-trip 在任何現存 engine 上從沒跑過。

## 四條腿現況（都讀過真實程式碼）

| Leg | 檔案 | 狀態 |
|-----|------|------|
| ABI wire format | `include/hybrid/state_abi.h:230` `struct hybrid_l2c` (整個 0x0000..0x0527 window, 165 qword) + `HYBRID_FLAG_L2C` | 完成 |
| QEMU drain | `qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c:441-451` 用 `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr(0xE0500000)` 抓整個 window | 完成 + 有測試 |
| vsim restore | `resume_driver.hpp:369` `restore_l2c` 只寫回 boot-static config（Control 0x08 / HPM 0x10 / 5 個 waymask）用 Program-Buffer `sw` | 程式碼完成，**gated off** |
| vsim drain | `state_drain.hpp:234` `drain_l2c` 用 `lwu` 讀回同一組 config | 程式碼完成，**gated off** |
| verify | `driver/state_diff.cpp:175-180` 比 `l2c.ctrl`（mask 掉 RO 的 INITSTATUS[14]） | 完成 |

## 我們做過什麼（git 紀錄）

andesim repo:
- `41260b2` L2C MMIO transport - Control register (ABI v5), minimal
- `b2bd4c6` L2C full window + reset-default test, complete

vsim repo (`/home/nick/work/vsim_andesim`):
- `edfd39c` pin ABI v5
- `47f3a7d` L2C restore via Program Buffer, minimal
- `7e7abc9` L2C restore/drain complete (HPM + way masks + drain)

QEMU repo:
- `andes_ae350.c:1491-1507` 把 L2C region 做成 RAM stub，並 seed Control Register `CEN=1`（DS220 11.8.7 reset 值）

兩個 plugin 測試：
- `test_plugin_l2c_drain.sh` - 寫 0xA5 到 0xE0500008，確認 plugin 抓到並設 flag
- `test_plugin_l2c_reset_default.sh` - 就算 guest 從沒寫過，也要 drain 出 `CEN=1`（不能把 guest 預設的 L2-enabled 誤傳成 disabled）

## 真正的 gap（誠實講）

兩個原因讓它「轉移正確性」還沒被真的驗證：

1. **QEMU 是 RAM stub 不是 functional L2C**（`andes_ae350.c:1498`）。整個 1MB region 就是一塊零初始化的 RAM，只有 offset 0x08 被塞了 `CEN=1`。guest 寫什麼、plugin 就原封不動 drain 回什麼。這對「搬 boot-static config」夠用，但它沒有 model 任何 L2C 行為（CCTL 指令副作用、INITSTATUS、真實 config 語意都沒有）。

2. **vsim 側在所有現存 engine 上是關掉的**。我查了實際 build config：
   - `build/Vax45mpv_premium/obj_sc/config.inc`: `NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB 0`
   - `build/Vax46mpv_advanced/obj_sc/config.inc`: `NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB 0`
   
   `l2c_present()` = `_NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB > 0`（`simulator.hpp:387`），所以每個 engine 都 `false`，`restore_l2c`/`drain_l2c` 一進去就 return。**vsim 從沒真的對 L2C RTL 執行過這段 restore/drain。**（注意 config 裡 `NDS_L2C_REG_BASE=0xE0500000` 有定義，但 size 是 0 → cache 不存在。）

所以要真正驗證 QEMU<->vsim 的 L2C round-trip，缺的是**一個 `NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB > 0` 的 engine build**。有了它，vsim 的 `l2c_present()` 才會變 true，那段 Program-Buffer 存取才會真的落到 L2C RTL 上，`--verify` 才會實際比對到非零的結果。

## 下一步（你決定）

現在能立刻做、且有意義的只有一件：**跑那兩個 plugin 測試，證明 QEMU-drain 這條腿在你機器上是綠的**（vsim 那條腿沒 L2C engine 沒辦法跑）。

要我現在跑 `test_plugin_l2c_drain.sh` + `test_plugin_l2c_reset_default.sh` 嗎？還是你想先往下一個 memory-map region（例如 PLIC / PLICSW / L2C 以外會影響 performance 的）繼續盤點？

1	// Program Buffer execution helpers for the RISC-V Debug Module.
2	//
3	// Follows the same duck-typed template pattern as dmi_poll.hpp so that
4	// resume_driver.hpp can include this header without a circular dependency.
5	// Bus type requirement: write(uint8_t reg, uint32_t val) and
6	//                       read(uint8_t reg) -> uint32_t.
7	//
8	// Debug Spec references: section 3.6 (Program Buffer), table 3.1 (DMI),
9	// section 3.7.1.3 (Abstract Command - Access Register).
10	
11	#pragma once
12	
13	#include "hybrid/abstract_command.hpp"
14	#include "hybrid/dmi_poll.hpp"
15	
16	#include <array>
17	#include <cstdint>
18	#include <span>
19	#include <stdexcept>
20	#include <string>
21	
22	namespace hybrid {
23	
24	// DMI address of the first Program Buffer register (progbuf0..progbuf15).
25	inline constexpr uint8_t kProgbuf0 = 0x20u;
26	
27	// Max payload instructions: 16 total slots minus 1 reserved for the
28	// mandatory ebreak that terminates execution.
29	inline constexpr std::size_t kProgbufMaxInsns = 15u;
30	
31	// Standard ebreak encoding (funct12=1, opcode=SYSTEM).
32	inline constexpr uint32_t kEbreak = 0x00100073u;
33	
34	// "Execute Program Buffer only" command (Debug Spec table 3.1):
35	//   cmdtype  = 0 (Access Register)
36	//   aarsize  = Bits64 (3) - ignored by DM when transfer=0, set for consistency
37	//   postexec = 1 (bit 18)
38	//   transfer = 0 (bit 17 NOT set) - skip register I/O, only run progbuf
39	//   write    = 0 (irrelevant when transfer=0)
40	//   regno    = 0 (irrelevant when transfer=0)
41	inline constexpr uint32_t kExecProgbufCmd =
42	    (uint32_t(AarSize::Bits64) & 0x7u) << 20 | (1u << 18);
43	
44	// Encode `vsetvl rd, rs1, rs2` (RVV 1.0 section 6.2, funct7=1000000).
45	// Tier-B restore: stage vl in rs1 and vtype in rs2 via Abstract Commands,
46	// then branch-free-restore both in one Program Buffer execution.
47	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_vsetvl(uint8_t rd, uint8_t rs1, uint8_t rs2)
48	{
49	    return (0b1000000u << 25)
50	         | ((uint32_t(rs2) & 0x1Fu) << 20)
51	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
52	         | (0b111u << 12)
53	         | ((uint32_t(rd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
54	         | 0x57u;  // OP-V opcode
55	}
56	
57	// Encode `csrrw rd, csr, rs1` (SYSTEM opcode, funct3=001).
58	// Tier-A PB fallback: stage the CSR value in rs1 via Abstract Command,
59	// then write it to a CSR that the DM cannot reach via abstract access.
60	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_csrrw(uint8_t rd, uint16_t csr, uint8_t rs1)
61	{
62	    return ((uint32_t(csr) & 0xFFFu) << 20)
63	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
64	         | (0b001u << 12)
65	         | ((uint32_t(rd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
66	         | 0x73u;  // SYSTEM opcode
67	}
68	
69	// Encode `vle8.v vd, (rs1)` - unit-stride vector load, EEW=8 (RVV 1.0 sec 7.4).
70	// Fields: vm=1 (unmasked, bit 25), width=000, mop=00, mew=0, nf=000,
71	// lumop=00000, opcode LOAD-FP=0x07. PB V-regfile reload sweeps v0..v31 from
72	// the shared scratch region after a vsetvl to e8/m1.
73	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_vle8_v(uint8_t vd, uint8_t rs1)
74	{
75	    return (1u << 25)
76	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
77	         | ((uint32_t(vd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
78	         | 0x07u;  // LOAD-FP opcode
79	}
80	
81	// Encode `vse8.v vs3, (rs1)` - unit-stride vector store, EEW=8. Mirror of
82	// encode_vle8_v with opcode STORE-FP=0x27. PB V-regfile dump sweeps v0..v31
83	// back to the shared scratch region at drain.
84	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_vse8_v(uint8_t vs3, uint8_t rs1)
85	{
86	    return (1u << 25)
87	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
88	         | ((uint32_t(vs3) & 0x1Fu) << 7)
89	         | 0x27u;  // STORE-FP opcode
90	}
91	
92	// Encode `addi rd, rs1, imm12` (OP-IMM opcode 0x13, funct3=000). The batched
93	// V-data sweep advances the scratch base pointer x7 by one register-span
94	// between transfers WITHIN a Program-Buffer execution, so the per-register
95	// abstract x7 write disappears. imm12 is a signed 12-bit field (-2048..2047).
96	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_addi(uint8_t rd, uint8_t rs1, int32_t imm12)
97	{
98	    return ((uint32_t(imm12) & 0xFFFu) << 20)
99	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
100	         | ((uint32_t(rd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
101	         | 0x13u;  // OP-IMM opcode (funct3=000)
102	}
103	
104	// Encode `lwu rd, imm12(rs1)` (LOAD opcode 0x03, funct3=110 for 32-bit ZERO-
105	// extend, I-type). L2C MMIO registers must be accessed less than 8 bytes at a
106	// time (DS220 11.8.3), so the L2C config read-back loads a word. lwu (not lw)
107	// so a 32-bit register value does not sign-extend into the upper bits of the
108	// 64-bit GPR it lands in.
109	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_lwu(uint8_t rd, uint8_t rs1, int32_t imm12)
110	{
111	    return ((uint32_t(imm12) & 0xFFFu) << 20)
112	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
113	         | (0b110u << 12)
114	         | ((uint32_t(rd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
115	         | 0x03u;  // LOAD opcode
116	}
117	
118	// Encode `sw rs2, imm12(rs1)` (STORE opcode 0x23, funct3=010 for 32-bit,
119	// S-type: imm[11:5] -> bits 31:25, imm[4:0] -> bits 11:7). L2C MMIO registers
120	// must be accessed less than 8 bytes at a time (DS220 11.8.3), so the L2C
121	// config restore writes a word. All documented L2C control bits live in the
122	// low 32 bits.
123	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_sw(uint8_t rs2, uint8_t rs1, int32_t imm12)
124	{
125	    const uint32_t imm = uint32_t(imm12) & 0xFFFu;
126	    return ((imm >> 5) & 0x7Fu) << 25
127	         | ((uint32_t(rs2) & 0x1Fu) << 20)
128	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
129	         | (0b010u << 12)
130	         | ((imm & 0x1Fu) << 7)
131	         | 0x23u;  // STORE opcode
132	}
133	
134	// Write insns[0..n-1] to progbuf0..n-1 and kEbreak to progbuf[n].
135	// Clears any sticky abstractcs.cmderr (W1C), issues kExecProgbufCmd, polls
136	// until abstractcs.busy clears, then verifies cmderr stayed clear.
137	//
138	// Throws std::runtime_error if insns.size() > kProgbufMaxInsns, if the poll
139	// times out, or if the DM raises cmderr during execution. No caller has a
140	// legitimate reason to silently continue on PB failure - the hart state
141	// would be partially restored / partially drained, which is worse than
142	// surfacing the fault.
143	template<typename Bus>
144	inline void exec_progbuf(Bus& bus, std::span<const uint32_t> insns)
145	{
146	    if (insns.size() > kProgbufMaxInsns)
147	        throw std::runtime_error(
148	            "exec_progbuf: too many instructions ("
149	            + std::to_string(insns.size()) + " > "
150	            + std::to_string(kProgbufMaxInsns) + ")");
151	
152	    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < insns.size(); ++i)
153	        bus.write(static_cast<uint8_t>(kProgbuf0 + i), insns[i]);
154	    bus.write(static_cast<uint8_t>(kProgbuf0 + insns.size()), kEbreak);
155	
156	    if ((bus.read(kDmiAbstractcs) & kAbstractcsCmderrMask) != 0u)
157	        bus.write(kDmiAbstractcs, kAbstractcsCmderrMask);
158	
159	    bus.write(kDmiCommand, kExecProgbufCmd);
160	    poll_until_clear(bus, kDmiAbstractcs, kAbstractcsBusy, "exec_progbuf busy");
161	
162	    const uint32_t cmderr = bus.read(kDmiAbstractcs) & kAbstractcsCmderrMask;
163	    if (cmderr != 0u)
164	        throw std::runtime_error(
165	            "exec_progbuf: PB execution raised cmderr="
166	            + std::to_string(cmderr >> 8));
167	}
168	
169	// vtype encoding for e8, m8, ta, ma (vsew=000, vlmul=011, vta=1, vma=1). The
170	// V-data sweep uses LMUL=8 so one vle8.v/vse8.v moves a whole group of 8
171	// registers (8*vlenb byte-elements, vl=8*vlenb) in a single instruction.
172	inline constexpr uint32_t kVtypeE8M8 = 0xC3u;
173	
174	// Abstract-command write of a 64-bit value to Debug Module register `regno`
175	// (GPR/CSR/FPR): DATA0/DATA1 + Access-Register(write) + busy-poll. Free
176	// function so ResumeDriver, StateDrain, and the V-data sweep share one copy.
177	template<typename Bus>
178	inline void write_register_abstract(Bus& bus, uint16_t regno, uint64_t value)
179	{
180	    bus.write(kDmiData0, static_cast<uint32_t>(value & 0xffffffffu));
181	    bus.write(kDmiData1, static_cast<uint32_t>((value >> 32) & 0xffffffffu));
182	    bus.write(kDmiCommand,
183	              access_register_command(regno, AarSize::Bits64, /*write=*/true));
184	    poll_until_clear(bus, kDmiAbstractcs, kAbstractcsBusy,
185	                     "write_register_abstract");
186	}
187	
188	// Sweep all 32 V data registers between the hart regfile and the vlenb-packed
189	// scratch region via the Program Buffer. load=true issues vle8.v
190	// (scratch -> regfile, on resume); load=false issues vse8.v (regfile ->
191	// scratch, at drain). The leading vsetvl to e8/m8 sets vl=8*vlenb and forces
192	// vstart=0, so one unit-stride access covers a whole LMUL=8 group of 8
193	// registers. Uses x5/x6 (vsetvl operands) and x7 (group base pointer) as
194	// scratch. `vlenb` is the runtime per-register width; the scratch must be
195	// packed at vlenb stride (stage_v_to_scratch) so each 8-register group is
196	// contiguous.
197	template<typename Bus>
198	inline void pb_v_data_sweep(Bus& bus, uint64_t scratch_gpa, uint64_t vlenb,
199	                            bool load)
200	{
201	    // The scratch holds v0..v31 packed contiguously at vlenb stride (see
202	    // stage_v_to_scratch), so 8 consecutive registers form one LMUL=8 group.
203	    // One vle8.v/vse8.v then moves a whole group (8*vlenb contiguous bytes,
204	    // vl=8*vlenb) and all 32 registers transfer in 4 grouped ops -- whose 4
205	    // (transfer; addi) pairs fit in a SINGLE Program-Buffer execution. Each PB
206	    // execution is one halted-hart DM round-trip (~1000 sim cycles in the
207	    // busy-poll), so this is the floor: one vsetvl + one grouped execution. The
208	    // register bytes never cross DMI; they ride the shared mmap.
209	    constexpr unsigned     kRegsPerGroup   = 8;  // LMUL=8
210	    // kVtypeE8M8's vlmul field (bits 2:0) must encode this LMUL, so one grouped
211	    // vle8.v/vse8.v really covers kRegsPerGroup registers (integer LMUL=1<<vlmul;
212	    // 0xC3 & 7 == 3 -> LMUL 8).
213	    static_assert((1u << (kVtypeE8M8 & 0x7u)) == kRegsPerGroup,
214	                  "kVtypeE8M8 must encode LMUL = kRegsPerGroup");
215	    constexpr std::size_t  kGroupSweepInsns = (32 / kRegsPerGroup) * 2;  // (ld;addi)*4
216	    static_assert(kGroupSweepInsns <= kProgbufMaxInsns,
217	                  "the grouped sweep must fit one Program Buffer execution");
218	    const uint64_t group_bytes = static_cast<uint64_t>(kRegsPerGroup) * vlenb;
219	    if (group_bytes > 2047)  // addi imm12 is signed 12-bit; max 8*128 = 1024
220	        throw std::runtime_error(
221	            "pb_v_data_sweep: 8*vlenb exceeds the addi imm12 range");
222	
223	    // vsetvl to e8/m8 with AVL = 8*vlenb sets vl = VLMAX = 8*vlenb (one
224	    // byte-element per lane across the whole group) and forces vstart = 0.
225	    write_register_abstract(bus, regno_gpr(5), group_bytes);  // AVL
226	    write_register_abstract(bus, regno_gpr(6), kVtypeE8M8);   // e8, m8, ta, ma
227	    const std::array<uint32_t, 1> pb_vsetvl = { encode_vsetvl(0, 5, 6) };
228	    exec_progbuf(bus, std::span<const uint32_t>{pb_vsetvl});
229	
230	    // Base pointer x7 staged once; the in-buffer addi advances it one group at
231	    // a time. The group base register must be LMUL-aligned: v0/v8/v16/v24.
232	    write_register_abstract(bus, regno_gpr(7), scratch_gpa);
233	    const uint32_t addi_step =
234	        encode_addi(7, 7, static_cast<int32_t>(group_bytes));
235	    std::array<uint32_t, kGroupSweepInsns> group_sweep{};
236	    std::size_t n = 0;
237	    for (uint8_t g = 0; g < 32; g += kRegsPerGroup) {
238	        group_sweep[n++] = load ? encode_vle8_v(g, 7) : encode_vse8_v(g, 7);
239	        group_sweep[n++] = addi_step;  // last group's addi is harmless dead work
240	    }
241	    exec_progbuf(bus, std::span<const uint32_t>{group_sweep.data(), n});
242	}
243	
244	}  // namespace hybrid

content.text:
讀完 `program_buffer.hpp` 和 `abstract_command.hpp`，機制完全清楚了。

## 一句話關鍵

**Abstract Command 碰不到 MMIO** - DM 的 Access Register 只能存取 register file（GPR/FPR/CSR）。MMIO 是掛在 bus 上的 device。所以要寫 0xE0500008 這種位址，做法是：**讓「halted 的 hart」透過 Program Buffer 執行一條真的 `sw` 指令**。hart 是 bus master，它這條 store 就走正常的 system bus，打進 vsim RTL 裡真正的 L2C device。

## 先澄清 "ram stub" 這個詞

RAM stub **只存在 QEMU 那邊** - 它是 QEMU 假裝有 L2C 的手段。vsim 那邊沒有 stub，是真的 L2C RTL（當 `NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB>0` 時）。

我們**不是搬那塊 stub 記憶體**。流程是：QEMU 從 stub 讀出「register 的值」-> 存進 `hybrid_state_v1.l2c.reg[]` -> vsim 把其中「可寫的 config register」的值，當成真正的 bus store 重放進 RTL。值是透過 DMI 的 DATA0/DATA1 當 GPR payload 過去的，不是記憶體 image。

## 完整 trace：restore Control Register (0xE0500008)

來源 `resume_driver.hpp` 的 `pb_store_l2c_reg(0x0008, value)`，展開成實際的 DMI bus 動作：

```
// ---- Step 1: 用 Abstract Command 把 MMIO 位址塞進 x6 ----
// write_register_abstract(x6, 0xE0500000 + 0x0008)
bus.write(DATA0=0x04, low32(0xE0500008))     // 位址低 32 bit
bus.write(DATA1=0x05, high32(0xE0500008))    // 位址高 32 bit
bus.write(COMMAND=0x17, AccessReg(regno=0x1006, Bits64, write=1))  // "把 DATA1:DATA0 寫進 x6"
poll abstractcs.busy 清掉                      // 等 DM 做完
// 現在 hart 的 x6 = 0xE0500008

// ---- Step 2: 用 Abstract Command 把 value 塞進 x5 ----
// write_register_abstract(x5, value & 0xffffffff)
bus.write(DATA0, low32(value))
bus.write(DATA1, 0)
bus.write(COMMAND, AccessReg(regno=0x1005, Bits64, write=1))       // "寫進 x5"
poll busy
// 現在 hart 的 x5 = 要寫的 config 值

// ---- Step 3: 用 Program Buffer 執行 sw x5, 0(x6) ----
// exec_progbuf({ encode_sw(5,6,0) })
bus.write(PROGBUF0=0x20, encode_sw(5,6,0))    // progbuf0 = "sw x5, 0(x6)"
bus.write(PROGBUF1=0x21, 0x00100073)          // progbuf1 = ebreak (結束 PB 執行)
bus.write(COMMAND, kExecProgbufCmd)           // postexec=1, transfer=0 -> "只跑 progbuf"
poll busy; 檢查 cmderr 沒亮
// hart 執行 sw x5, 0(x6) -> 一筆 store 打上 bus -> 命中 L2C RTL 的 Control Register
```

值的完整旅程：
```
QEMU L2C RAM stub
   -> plugin qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr  (drain)
   -> hybrid_state_v1.l2c.reg[1]             (wire file)
   -> DMI DATA0/DATA1 -> 寫進 hart 的 x5/x6  (abstract cmd)
   -> Program Buffer 的 sw x5,0(x6)          (hart 執行)
   -> system bus store -> vsim L2C RTL       (真正落地)
```

Drain 是完全對稱的鏡像（`state_drain.hpp` 的 `pb_load_l2c_reg`）：abstract 寫位址進 x6 -> PB 跑 `lwu x5, 0(x6)`（hart 從 MMIO 讀進 x5）-> abstract 讀回 x5。

## 三種 transport tier 的對比（這是重點）

| 要搬的東西 | 用什麼 | 為什麼 |
|-----------|--------|--------|
| GPR / FPR / CSR | **純 Abstract Command** | DM 直接搬 DATA0/DATA1 <-> register，不執行任何指令 |
| **L2C MMIO** | **Program Buffer** (`sw`/`lwu`) | MMIO 在 bus 上，abstract 碰不到；借 x5/x6 當 scratch，叫 hart 跑 load/store |
| V data regs (v0..v31) | **Program Buffer** (`vle8`/`vse8`) + 共享 mmap scratch page | 32 個 vector reg 太大，塞不進 DATA0/DATA1，改走 mmap |

差別在：CSR 是「DM 直接存取 register」；MMIO 是「叫 hart 執行指令，MMIO 存取只是那條指令的 side effect」。

## 兩個容易漏掉的細節

1. **hart 必須是 halted（debug mode）**。handoff controller 在 ResumeDriver 跑之前，先用 DMI 把 hart 停住。PB 指令在 debug mode 下用 hart 平常的 privilege/MMU context 跑；M-mode boot flow paging 是關的，所以 VA==PA，`x6 = 實體 L2C 位址` 直接命中。

2. **為什麼是 `sw`/`lwu`（32-bit）不是 `sd`/`ld`（64-bit）**。DS220 11.8.3 規定 L2C MMIO 一次存取要小於 8 bytes，且所有 config bit 都在低 32 bit，所以 `encode_sw`/`encode_lwu` + `value & 0xffffffff`（`program_buffer.hpp:118-132`）。

content: 先告訴我結論就好 不要改

content.text:
決定性證據到手。`load_elf`（simulator.hpp:497-512）在 `skip_memory_load=true` 時**完全不載入記憶體**，而且就算載入，`read_elf_into_memory` 也只寫 `platform.main_memory`（DRAM），從不寫 ILM/DLM。三個缺口全部確認。

## 一句話結論

分兩層看：**config CSR (`milmb`/`mdlmb`) 有轉**（但 verify-excluded）；**ILM/DLM 的記憶體 CONTENT 完全沒轉** - vsim resume 時 local memory 是 RTL reset 的空狀態。所以你問的這兩塊「有支援」只到 config 層級，資料層級沒有。

## 先分清楚兩個 "base"（理解一切的關鍵）

同一塊實體 local memory，有兩個位址視角：

| 視角 | 位址 | 誰用 |
|------|------|------|
| **Slave Port aperture**（你貼的這兩個） | ILM `0xA0000000`, DLM `0xA0200000` | 外部 master (DMA / debug / 別的 hart) 從這裡進 hart0 的 TCM |
| Hart 自己的 local view | `milmb`/`mdlmb` base，預設 ILM `0x0` / DLM `0x200000` | 跑在 hart 上的 program |

兩邊都剛好對上你給的位址：
- QEMU `andes_ae350.c:74-75`: `SUBPORT0_ILM={0xa0000000,0x200000}`, `SUBPORT0_DLM={0xa0200000,...}`
- vsim `memory_map.h:12-17`: `HART0_ILM_BASE=0xA0000000`, `HART0_DLM_BASE=0xA0200000`，綁在 CPU 的 `slv_bfm`（RTL 裡的 local RAM）

## 第 1 層：config CSR - 有轉

`milmb`(0x7C0)/`mdlmb`(0x7C1) 在 v3 Andes block（`state_abi.h:106-107`），走完整 drain -> restore -> re-read。但 **verify-excluded**（`state_diff.cpp:96-100`）：
- base 位址會 round-trip、會對。
- 但 enable bit (bit 0) reset 分歧：QEMU `ilm_default_enable=false`（`andes_ae350.c:1705`）-> drain `EN=0`；vsim RTL 真的有 local memory -> drain `EN=1`。所以整個 CSR 被排除在嚴格比對外，不是 half-compare。

## 第 2 層：memory CONTENT - 沒轉（三個獨立缺口）

| 缺口 | 證據 |
|------|------|
| 不在共享 mmap | QEMU 把 ILM/DLM 做成獨立 device region (`env->mask_ilm`/`mask_dlm`)；共享 `memory-backend` 只 back DRAM `{0x0, 0x80000000}`（`andes_ae350.c:71`） |
| plugin 沒 drain | `hybrid_handoff.c` 全檔只有一次 `read_memory_hwaddr`，那是 L2C（line 444）。ILM/DLM 沒有 |
| vsim 沒從 ELF 補 | `load_elf` 只寫 `platform.main_memory`（simulator.hpp:506-509），且 hybrid 是 `skip_memory_load=true` 直接跳過 |

三條路都不通 -> **vsim resume 時 ILM/DLM 內容 = RTL reset（空）**。

## 這代表什麼 / 什麼時候會爆

- **今天沒事（latent，不是 active bug）**：所有 fixture + vplat runtime 都 link 進 DRAM，沒有任何一個把 code/data 放進 TCM（前面 grep 過，andesim 裡只有 `milmb`/`mdlmb` 的 CSR 名字，沒有任何 ILM/DLM content 處理或 fixture）。

- **但這正是最該擔心 performance 的地方**：ILM/DLM 就是 TCM - 單 cycle 的 tightly-coupled memory，比走 cache 的 DRAM 快很多。一個把 hot loop 放 ILM、hot array 放 DLM 的 benchmark：
  - ROI 內若 fetch ILM 的 code 或讀 DLM 的 data -> vsim 那邊是空的 -> 跑錯 or fetch garbage。
  - 就算內容湊巧對，`milmb`/`mdlmb` 的 enable 又是 reset-divergent。
  - 這跟 L2C 的動機一模一樣（「resume 時 cache/TCM 狀態不對 -> cycle 數大錯」），但 L2C 做了、ILM/DLM 沒做。

## 如果未來要支援

2. bulk 複製（drain 整塊進 handoff file，vsim 端用 DMA/mmap 灌回）- 像 L2C window 但資料量大很多。

這是另一個設計討論，要做再展開。

content.text:
QEMU ILM/DLM size：**預設各 2MB，可設定**。

## Default（`andes_ae350.c:1701-1704`）
| | size | base |
|---|---|---|
| ILM | `0x200000` = 2MB | `0x0` |
| DLM | `0x200000` = 2MB | `0x200000` |
- `ilm_default_enable` / `dlm_default_enable` = **false**（milmb/mdlmb 的 EN reset 為 0）。

## Configurable：yes
device/machine property：`ilm_size`、`dlm_size`、`ilm_base`、`dlm_base`。例如 `-machine andes_ae350,ilm_size=0x10000,dlm_size=0x8000`。

**合法範圍**（`andes_ae350.c:906-933` + `andes_ae350.h:237-238`）：
- size 必須是 **0（= 不接、disable）** 或 **2 的次方**，介於 `ANDES_LM_SIZE_MIN=0x400`（1KB）到 `ANDES_LM_SIZE_MAX=0x20000000`（512MB）。
- base 必須對齊 size。

## 跟 hybrid 有關的一個重點
vsim RTL 那邊的 size 是 **build 時寫死的、不是 runtime configurable**：`ax45mpv_premium` 是 `NDS_ILM_SIZE_KB=64`（64KB）/ `NDS_DLM_SIZE_KB=32`（32KB）。

所以 QEMU 預設(2MB/2MB) 跟 vsim(64KB/32KB) **連 size 都對不起來** - 這是除了「content 沒轉」之外的另一個不一致點。真要在 hybrid 用 TCM，QEMU 這邊得用 `ilm_size=0x10000,dlm_size=0x8000` 之類把 size 調到跟目標 engine 的 RTL 一致。

content.text:
**YES** - `--print-qemu-config` 有 print，而且是真的會被餵進 QEMU 的。

## 它印什麼（ax45mpv_premium 的 `qemu.cfg`）
```
driver = "riscv.andes.ae350.soc"
  ilm_base           = 0x0
  dlm_base           = 0x200000
  ilm_size           = 65536      # 64KB
  dlm_size           = 32768      # 32KB
  ilm_default_enable = on
  dlm_default_enable = on
```
size、base、default_enable 全都印。

## 這不是裝飾 - driver 會拿它去設定 QEMU
`stage_qemu_cfg()`（`run_plan.hpp:67-73`）把 `<engine> --print-qemu-config` 的 stdout 寫成 `workdir/qemu.cfg`，然後注入 `-readconfig <cfg>` 到 **QEMU leg（含 hybrid 的 QEMU1）**，vsim leg 不吃（`plan_test.cpp:228-247`）。目的就是讓 QEMU 的 SoC config 跟目標 engine 的 RTL 對齊。

## 修正我前面講錯的一點
我上一輪說「QEMU 預設 2MB/2MB 跟 vsim 64KB/32KB 連 size 都對不起來」- 那是 QEMU **compiled-in default**。但走 `andesim` driver 的真實 hybrid run，QEMU 被這個 cfg override 成 **64KB/32KB，剛好等於 vsim RTL**（`NDS_ILM_SIZE_KB=64`/`NDS_DLM_SIZE_KB=32`）。所以 size 在 driver 路徑下是**對得起來的**，我前面那句話錯了。

另外 cfg 設 `ilm/dlm_default_enable=on`，代表 driver 路徑下 QEMU 的 `milmb/mdlmb` EN reset=1（不是 raw default 的 false）。`state_diff.cpp:98` 那句「QEMU drains EN=0」看起來是對著 raw default 寫的；cfg 路徑下 EN 其實會是 1。我沒重跑去確認 milmb 現在是否完全 round-trip，所以只講到這 - 不多斷言。

注意兩條路徑行為不同：
- **`andesim` driver**：吃 `-readconfig qemu.cfg` -> size 64KB/32KB、EN=on。
- **plugin 測試腳本**（`test_plugin_l2c_*.sh` 用 `-cpu andes-ax45mpv` 直接下）：不吃 cfg -> QEMU default 2MB/2MB、EN=off。

**不變的結論**：就算 size 對齊、EN=on，ILM/DLM 的 **content 還是沒轉**（不在 mmap、沒 drain、vsim `load_elf` 只寫 main_memory）。content 那層結論不受影響。

沒有任何改動。

message.content: 1. vsim 原本的--ilm --dlm 是怎樣塞到 RTL? 也是走PB?

content.text: 我前面說是 backdoor 不走 PB，但那是推論 - 我還沒真的讀 `set_ilm` 的 body。直接讀 code 確認。

讀完了。答案：**不走 PB，完全不碰 bus/DMI**。是 Verilator backdoor - 直接寫進 Verilated model 內部的 SRAM 陣列。

## 實際機制（`ax45mpv_premium_cpu_cluster_subsystem.hpp:392-437`）

`set_ilm` 拿一個 hierarchical reference 直接指到 RTL 內部的 memory 陣列：
```cpp
auto& mem = this->rootp
  ->ae350_vcpu_cluster_subsystem__DOT__u_cluster__DOT__u_complex0
    __DOT__u_core0__DOT__u_ilm_ram0__DOT__ram_inst__DOT__mem;

for (i ...) mem[i] = word;   // 直接寫，沒有任何 transaction
```
`__DOT__` 是 Verilator 把 RTL 階層 `.` 編碼出來的 C++ 名字。`rootp` 是 Verilated 設計的根。所以它就是**繞過 hart、繞過 bus、繞過 debug module，直接 poke 那塊 SRAM 的內部陣列**。純模擬手段，真實硬體和 DMI 都做不到這件事。不花任何 sim cycle。

## 三種機制對照（串起我們整場對話）

| 搬什麼 | 機制 | 走 bus/RTL 邏輯? | 花 sim cycle? |
|--------|------|:---:|:---:|
| GPR/FPR/CSR | DMI **Abstract Command** | 是（真 debug 協定） | 是 |
| L2C MMIO / V-data | DMI **Program Buffer**（hart 跑 `sw`/`vle8`） | 是（hart 執行真指令） | 是 |
| **ILM/DLM `set_ilm`** | **Verilator 階層引用直寫 `mem[]`** | **否（純 backdoor）** | **否** |

## 一個相關細節：它自己算 ECC
set_ilm 不只寫 data，還手動產生 ECC/parity 打包進記憶體字（rv64+ecc 是 bits[71:64]，line 427-436）。因為它直寫 SRAM，而 SRAM 存的是 data+ECC 一起；正常 store 是硬體 ECC 邏輯幫你算，backdoor 得自己補。

**對 plan 的意義**：因為是 backdoor 直寫、不是 L2C 那種 per-word PB store，vsim 端 restore ILM/DLM 才會「幾乎免費」且瞬間完成。而且 plugin 只需 drain **raw data**（ECC 由 set_ilm 重算），不用管 ECC bits。這更確定了路線 A（重用 `--ilm`/`--dlm`）是對的。

# ROADMAP: ILM/DLM content transport across the hybrid handoff (Approach A)

Goal: make Hart 0 ILM (`0xA0000000..0xA01FFFFF`) and DLM (`0xA0200000..0xA03FFFFF`)
memory CONTENT survive the QEMU1 -> vsim handoff, so a benchmark whose hot
code/data lives in TCM measures correct results and correct cycles.

Scope: content only. The config CSRs (`milmb`/`mdlmb`) are already transported in
the v3 Andes block (verify-excluded). This roadmap is about the bytes.

## Why this matters
ILM/DLM are TCM (tightly-coupled memory) = single-cycle local RAM, the most
performance-relevant memory in the AE350. Today the content is NOT transported
(3 gaps: not in the shared mmap, plugin does not drain it, vsim `load_elf` only
targets main_memory). vsim resumes with ILM/DLM at RTL reset (empty). Latent
today (no fixture uses TCM); breaks/mis-measures any TCM benchmark.

## Chosen approach: A (file sidecar + reuse `--ilm`/`--dlm`)
Plugin drains ILM/DLM to sidecar files next to the state `--outfile`; the driver
feeds them to the vsim leg via the EXISTING `--ilm`/`--dlm` args; vsim's existing
`load_image` backdoor writes them into the RTL.

Key reason A wins: the vsim restore leg already exists and is nearly free.
- `--ilm`/`--dlm` -> `Simulator::load_image` (`vsim: src/simulator.hpp:524`)
  -> `cpu.set_ilm`/`set_dlm`
  (`vsim: src/cpu_wrappers/ax45mpv_premium_cpu_cluster_subsystem.hpp:392,466`).
- `set_ilm` is NOT a bus/PB/DMI transfer. It is a Verilator hierarchical-reference
  poke straight into the model SRAM array (`rootp->..__DOT__..mem[i] = word`),
  costs zero sim cycles, and regenerates ECC/parity itself. So the plugin only
  needs to drain RAW data; vsim rebuilds ECC.
- No ABI change: content rides sidecar files, `hybrid_state_v1` is untouched.

Alternatives (not chosen now): B shared-mmap-backed ILM/DLM (less invasive per
run but changes mmap layout on both sides + QEMU device model); C add an ABI
block (96KB into the state file, larger ABI surface). Revisit only if A hits a
wall.

## Established facts (verified in code; trust these, do not re-derive)
- QEMU slave port: `subport_create` (`qemu: hw/riscv/andes_ae350.c:1381`) maps
  `0xA0000000`/`0xA0200000` as `memory_region_init_io` with `subport_ops`, which
  dispatch to the hart-local `env->mask_ilm`/`env->mask_dlm`
  (`qemu: target/riscv/cpu_helper.c:1308-1330`). So the slave port aliases the
  real ILM/DLM content.
- Sizes: `ax45mpv_premium` = ILM 64KB / DLM 32KB (`vsim config.inc
  NDS_ILM_SIZE_KB=64 / NDS_DLM_SIZE_KB=32`). QEMU is synced to these via the
  `--print-qemu-config` -> `-readconfig qemu.cfg` path (`ilm_size=65536`,
  `dlm_size=32768`, `*_default_enable=on`). QEMU compiled-in defaults are 2MB/2MB
  but the driver overrides them. Sizes configurable via SoC props
  (`ilm_size`/`dlm_size`), valid range 0 or pow2 in [1KB, 512MB].
- Plugin drains exactly one region today (L2C, `qemu_plugin: hybrid_handoff.c:444`
  `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr`). Pattern to copy.
- vsim `load_image` order: `main.cpp:446` (before `sc_start` 453, before
  `sim.reset()` 529, before `apply_resume_from_qemu` 563).

## Biggest risk (gates the whole plan)
R1: `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr` on the subport IO region. The L2C drain works
because L2C is RAM (`init_ram`); the subport is `init_io`. Unknown whether the
plugin read API returns real content through IO dispatch. De-risked by F0. If it
fails, F0b (QEMU change) is required before F1.

Other risks:
- R2: does `sim.reset()` preserve backdoor-loaded SRAM? (F2)
- R3: ILM hart-local base is `0x0`, overlapping DRAM `0x0` -> ALWAYS drain via the
  slave-port aperture `0xA0000000`, never `0x0`.
- R4: single hart only (hart0), matching current hybrid scope.

## Features (TDD: each starts with a failing test; one feature per session)

Repos: `andesim` (driver, plugin, fixtures, tests), `vsim` = /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim,
`qemu` = /home/nick/work/qemu_andesim.

| ID | Name | State |
|----|------|-------|
| F0 | Spike: can the plugin read the subport IO region? (GATE) | TODO |
| F1 | Plugin drains ILM/DLM content to sidecar files | TODO |
| F2 | vsim resume-time LM load is correct + survives reset | TODO |
| F3 | Driver wires drained LM files into the vsim leg | TODO |
| F4 | E2E fixture: a real TCM benchmark round-trips | TODO |
| F5 | (stretch) --verify LM content round-trip | TODO |

### F0 - Spike / GATE
- Question: does `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr(0xA0000000, N)` return real ILM
  content when the subport is `init_io`?
- RED test: `tests/plugin/test_plugin_lm_drain.sh` + fixture that enables `milmb`,
  writes a known pattern at the hart-local ILM base, hits the marker; assert the
  plugin drained the pattern reading the SLAVE-PORT base `0xA0000000`. (Proves
  aliasing + drain together. A simpler variant writes+reads via `0xA0000000`.)
- Outcome A (works): F1 proceeds unchanged.
- Outcome B (fails/returns 0): add F0b = QEMU change to make the subport
  plugin-readable (RAM alias, or drain via a hart-local read path).
- Key files: `qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c` (throwaway probe),
  `tests/plugin/test_plugin_lm_drain.sh`, `tests/fixtures/lm_drain.{c,ld}`,
  `tests/fixtures/Makefile`
- Deps: none

### F1 - Plugin drains ILM/DLM content to sidecar files
- At the ROI-entry trigger, drain `ilm_size` bytes @ ilm base and `dlm_size` @ dlm
  base into `<outfile>.ilm` / `<outfile>.dlm`. New plugin args `ilm_base`,
  `ilm_size`, `dlm_base`, `dlm_size` (defaults `0xA0000000`/`0`/`0xA0200000`/`0`;
  size 0 => skip that memory, write no file). RAW bytes, little-endian.
- RED test: extend `test_plugin_lm_drain.sh` - pattern round-trips into both files;
  a `size=0` run produces no file (no regression for no-LM engines).
- Key files: `qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c`
- Deps: F0 (or F0b)

### F2 - vsim resume-time LM load correct + survives reset
- Confirm `--ilm`/`--dlm` -> `load_image` -> `set_ilm` populates RTL ILM/DLM AND
  the content survives `sim.reset()` and the DMI resume so the ROI sees it. If
  load-before-reset (main.cpp:446) is wiped by `reset()`, move the load to after
  reset / into `apply_resume_from_qemu`.
- RED test: hand-make a known `.bin`, `--ilm` it, reset, read back (mem[] or a tiny
  ROI that reads ILM and reports); assert intact.
- Key files: `vsim: src/main.cpp` (load ordering), maybe `vsim: src/simulator.hpp`
- Deps: none (independent; uses a hand-made bin)

### F3 - Driver wires drained LM files into the vsim leg
- Driver passes ilm/dlm base+size to the QEMU1 plugin (from the engine
  descriptor), predicts `<outfile>.ilm/.dlm`, and adds `--ilm <path> --dlm <path>`
  to the vsim argv - only when the engine has LM. Add `ilm_size`/`dlm_size` to the
  engine descriptor (`vsim: describe_engine` / `--print-qemu-config`) and parse it.
- RED test: `driver/plan_test.cpp` - vsim argv gets `--ilm/--dlm` iff engine has
  LM; QEMU argv gets the ilm/dlm plugin args; a no-LM engine adds neither.
- Key files: `driver/run_plan.cpp`, `driver/plan.hpp`, `driver/run_plan.hpp`,
  `driver/engine_registry.cpp`, `driver/plan_test.cpp`;
  cross-repo `vsim: src/main.cpp describe_engine`, `driver/json*.cpp`
- Deps: F1, F2

### F4 - E2E fixture: real TCM benchmark round-trips
- C fixture: hot loop resident in ILM, hot array in DLM (linker script places
  `.text.hot`->ILM, `.data.hot`->DLM). Run `andesim run --mode hybrid`; assert
  (a) ROI result correct, (b) cycle figure reflects TCM speed (sanity vs a DRAM
  variant of the same kernel).
- RED test: the fixture fails (wrong result / wrong cycles) until F1-F3 land.
- Key files: `tests/fixtures/rt_c_ilm_dlm.{c,ld}`, `tests/fixtures/Makefile`,
  `vsim: cmake/HybridConfig.cmake` (e2e registration), `tests/e2e.sh` if needed
- Deps: F3

### F5 - (stretch) --verify LM content round-trip
- StateDrain re-reads ILM/DLM at exit (a `get_ilm`/`get_dlm` backdoor dual, or a
  slave-port read); `state_diff` compares (full or checksum). Closes the loop.
- Key files: `vsim: src/hybrid/state_drain.hpp`, `vsim` cpu wrapper get_ilm/get_dlm,
  `driver/state_diff.cpp`
- Deps: F4

## Dependency graph
```
F0 (gate) -> F1 ─┐
F2 ──────────────┼─> F3 -> F4 -> F5 (stretch)
```

## Definition of done / invariants
- No `hybrid_state_v1` ABI change (content rides sidecar files).
- Active only when the engine has ILM/DLM AND size > 0; a no-LM engine adds no
  args, drains no files, changes nothing (zero regression).
- Plugin drains RAW data; vsim `set_ilm` regenerates ECC/parity.
- QEMU and vsim sizes stay synced (already true via qemu.cfg).
- Drain ALWAYS via the slave-port aperture (`0xA0000000`), never hart-local `0x0`.

## Progress log
- (unstarted) Next session: F0 (the gate). Do not start F1 until F0's outcome is
  known.

message.content: 所以qemu 會根據這個 cfg size 去設定ilm dlm size? 還是都固定?

content.text:
**RAM size 不固定 - QEMU 會照 cfg 的值去建那塊 ILM/DLM RAM。只有 slave-port 的 address aperture 是固定的。** 要分兩個東西講：

## 會被 cfg 決定的：實際的 RAM 大小
cfg 的 `ilm_size` 是 property override，走這條鏈變成真正的 RAM 區大小：
```
qemu.cfg ilm_size=65536
  -> SoC property "ilm_size"           (andes_ae350.c:1703, 預設 0x200000)
  -> env->ilm_size = isize             (cpu.c:640,643, 從 SoC prop 讀)
  -> memory_region_init_ram(env->mask_ilm, ..., env->ilm_size)   (cpu.c:673)
  -> map 在 env->ilm_base (0x0)         (cpu.c:680)
```
所以 cfg 給 65536 -> QEMU 真的建一塊 **64KB** 的 `mask_ilm`。沒 cfg -> 用 SoC 預設 **2MB**。這塊是 dynamic 的。

限制（`andes_ae350.c:906-933`）：size 要是 0 或 2 的次方，介於 1KB..512MB，base 要對齊 size。

## 固定的：slave-port 的 address 視窗
memmap 裡的 aperture 是編譯期常數，**固定 2MB**，跟 size 無關：
```
ANDES_AE350_SUBPORT0_ILM = { 0xa0000000, 0x200000 }   // 永遠 2MB 視窗
```
`subport_create` 用這個 2MB 建 IO region。所以：**視窗永遠是 0xA0000000..0xA01FFFFF (2MB)，但只有前 `ilm_size`(64KB) 有 RAM 撐**。超過 64KB 的部分打到 `mask_ilm` 範圍外，由 `subport_ops` 處理（不是真的記憶體）。

## 結論
- 記憶體大小：**跟著 cfg 走**（64KB/32KB），不是固定。
- 位址視窗：固定 2MB。
- 這也是為什麼 ROADMAP F1 寫「drain 只讀實際 `ilm_size`(64KB)，不是整個 2MB aperture」- 讀超過 64KB 沒有意義。

content.text:
讀完 QEMU 的 plugin API，F0 的擔心**基本上可以解除了** - 我前面過度謹慎。分兩段講。

## F0 原本在擔心什麼

QEMU 裡「記憶體」有兩種，讀法不一樣：

| 種類 | 怎麼建 | 是什麼 | plugin 好不好讀 |
|------|--------|--------|----------------|
| **RAM region** | `memory_region_init_ram` | 一塊真的 host 記憶體，就是 bytes | 好讀，直接抓指標 |
| **IO region** | `memory_region_init_io` | 不是 bytes，是一組 callback function（模擬 device 的讀寫行為） | **可能不好讀** |

- 我們之前 drain 的 **L2C 是 RAM region** -> plugin 讀成功。
- 但 **ILM/DLM 的 slave port (0xA0000000) 是 IO region**（`subport_create` 用 `memory_region_init_io`）。
- 我的擔心：plugin 的讀取 API 如果只支援 RAM、不支援 IO，那讀 0xA0000000 就會失敗（IO region 沒有「host 指標」可以直接抓，得去呼叫那個 device 的 read callback）。

## 我剛讀了 API，結論是：讀得到

`qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr`（`plugins/api.c:499-536`）內部用的是：
```c
address_space_rw(as, addr, ..., data, len, false);
```
`address_space_rw` 是 QEMU **完整的記憶體存取路徑** - 它會**呼叫 IO region 的 read callback**，不是只抓 RAM 指標。所以 IO region 也讀得到。對 subport 來說，它的 callback 會 dispatch 到 `env->mask_ilm`（`cpu_helper.c:1308-1311`），也就是真正的 ILM 內容。

**兩個證據：**
1. API 用 `address_space_rw` -> IO region 支援（會走 callback）。
2. L2C 的先例：L2C 也是掛在 system memory、用同一個 API 讀成功的 -> 證明 plugin 的 CPU address space 確實能到達這些 region。0xA0000000 一樣掛在 system memory，同一條路。

**唯一殘留的小前提**：讀的時候 ILM 要是 enabled 且讀在範圍內（前 64KB）。走 driver 的 cfg 路徑 `ilm_default_enable=on` 就滿足了。

## 對 ROADMAP 的影響

F0 從「**可能逼我們改 QEMU 的 gate**」降級成「**一個快速確認測試**」- 跑一下確認真的讀到就好，幾乎不會走到 F0b。路線 A 是安全的。

要我把 ROADMAP 的 F0 改成這個降級後的描述（gate -> quick confirm，附上這裡的 code 證據）嗎？

code/data lives in TCM measures correct results and correct cycles.

Scope: content only. The config CSRs (`milmb`/`mdlmb`) are already transported in
the v3 Andes block (verify-excluded). This roadmap is about the bytes.

## Why this matters
ILM/DLM are TCM (tightly-coupled memory) = single-cycle local RAM, the most
performance-relevant memory in the AE350. Today the content is NOT transported
(3 gaps: not in the shared mmap, plugin does not drain it, vsim `load_elf` only
targets main_memory). vsim resumes with ILM/DLM at RTL reset (empty). Latent
today (no fixture uses TCM); breaks/mis-measures any TCM benchmark.

## Chosen approach: A (file sidecar + reuse `--ilm`/`--dlm`)
Plugin drains ILM/DLM to sidecar files next to the state `--outfile`; the driver
feeds them to the vsim leg via the EXISTING `--ilm`/`--dlm` args; vsim's existing
`load_image` backdoor writes them into the RTL.

Key reason A wins: the vsim restore leg already exists and is nearly free.
- `--ilm`/`--dlm` -> `Simulator::load_image` (`vsim: src/simulator.hpp:524`)
  -> `cpu.set_ilm`/`set_dlm`

- `set_ilm` is NOT a bus/PB/DMI transfer. It is a Verilator hierarchical-reference
  poke straight into the model SRAM array (`rootp->..__DOT__..mem[i] = word`),
  costs zero sim cycles, and regenerates ECC/parity itself. So the plugin only
  needs to drain RAW data; vsim rebuilds ECC.
- No ABI change: content rides sidecar files, `hybrid_state_v1` is untouched.

Alternatives (not chosen now): B shared-mmap-backed ILM/DLM (less invasive per
run but changes mmap layout on both sides + QEMU device model); C add an ABI
block (96KB into the state file, larger ABI surface). Revisit only if A hits a

  dispatch to the hart-local `env->mask_ilm`/`env->mask_dlm`
  (`qemu: target/riscv/cpu_helper.c:1308-1330`). So the slave port aliases the
  real ILM/DLM content.
- Sizes are configurable, NOT fixed. QEMU builds the actual RAM at the property
  size: `qemu.cfg ilm_size` -> SoC prop -> `env->ilm_size`
  (`qemu: target/riscv/cpu.c:640,643`) -> `memory_region_init_ram(env->mask_ilm,
  env->ilm_size)` (`cpu.c:673`). `ax45mpv_premium` = ILM 64KB / DLM 32KB via the

  `dlm_size=32768`, `*_default_enable=on`). QEMU compiled-in defaults are 2MB/2MB
  but the driver overrides them. Only the slave-port ADDRESS window is fixed
  (2MB in the memmap); just the first `ilm_size` bytes are RAM-backed. Valid size
  0 or pow2 in [1KB, 512MB].
- Plugin drains exactly one region today (L2C, `qemu_plugin: hybrid_handoff.c:444`
  `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr`). Pattern to copy.
- vsim `load_image` order: `main.cpp:446` (before `sc_start` 453, before
  `sim.reset()` 529, before `apply_resume_from_qemu` 563).

- R1 (was the gate, now RESOLVED by code read): can the plugin read the subport IO

- R4: single hart only (hart0), matching current hybrid scope.

F4 的核心設計，一句話：**寫一個「在 QEMU 階段把 runtime 算出來的資料塞進 DLM，然後在 ROI(跑在 vsim)裡讀回來 checksum」的 fixture。只有 handoff 真的搬了內容，checksum 才會對。**

## 設計的關鍵：怎麼讓它「只有 transport 成功才會過」

最容易踩的坑：如果 test 用**靜態初始化的陣列**放進 DLM，那內容在 ELF 裡就有，vsim 有可能自己 load ELF 就過了 - 沒真的測到 handoff。

所以關鍵決定是用 **DLM `.bss` + runtime 計算**：
- `.bss` 在 ELF 裡是零（memsz > filesz，zero-fill），**ELF 完全沒有這些 bytes**。
- 值是在 QEMU 階段用迴圈算出來寫進去的，不是 static initializer。
- 結論：vsim 要看到正確的 DLM 內容，**只有一條路 - handoff 把它搬過來**。這就把 handoff transport 隔離成唯一變因。

## Fixture 長相（sketch）

```c
#include <andesim/ROI.h>
#define N 1024
static uint32_t dlm_buf[N] __attribute__((section(".dlm_bss")));  // DLM, .bss

__attribute__((section(".ilm_text"), noinline))                    // hot code in ILM
static uint32_t hot_reduce(const uint32_t *a, int n) {
  uint32_t s = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s += a[i] * 2654435761u;             // 迴圈跑在 ILM
  return s;
}

int main(void) {
  // ---- QEMU 階段：runtime 算出來塞進 DLM（不是 static array）----
  for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) dlm_buf[i] = (uint32_t)i * 2654435761u >> 24;

  // ---- handoff -> vsim ----
  andesim_ROI_begin();
  uint32_t sum = hot_reduce(dlm_buf, N);   // ILM 的 code 讀 DLM 的 data，都在 vsim
  printf("SUM=%08x\n", sum);               // 在 ROI 內回報，harness 抓 stdout
  andesim_ROI_end();

  return sum == EXPECTED ? 0 : 1;          // EXPECTED = 離線先算好的常數
}
```

Linker script 新增兩個 output section：`.ilm_text` -> ILM base、`.dlm_bss` -> DLM base。

## 兩層 assertion

| 層 | 測什麼 | 判定 | 強度 |
|----|--------|------|------|
| **正確性（hard）** | DLM 內容有沒有搬過去 | `SUM == EXPECTED`，不對就 FAIL | 決定性 - 這是主 assertion |
| **效能（soft/sanity）** | TCM 有沒有真的被用到（enable 有搬 + access 命中 local memory） | 同一 kernel 的 DRAM 版 vs TCM 版，`cycles(TCM) << cycles(DRAM)` | 佐證，門檻寬鬆 |

效能那層需要一個 DRAM 雙胞胎 fixture（同 kernel、全放 DRAM）對照。這證明的是「不只內容對，milmb/mdlmb enable 也搬對了，access 真的打到 TCM 不是 fallback 回 DRAM」。

## 自我驗證（negative control）

這個 fixture **今天就會 FAIL**（DLM 在 vsim 是空的 -> sum 用到零 -> checksum 錯），F1-F3 做完才會 PASS。所以它本身就是 RED->GREEN 的 regression guard，不用另外造假失敗。

## Input / Output（給你驗收用）

- **Input**：`andesim run --mode hybrid --trigger marker rt_c_ilm_dlm.elf`（走標準 e2e harness、shared mmap、vplat runtime）。
- **Output**：stdout 一行 `SUM=xxxxxxxx` + exit code。harness assert `SUM==EXPECTED` 且 exit 0。

## 一個要先解的硬骨頭（屬於 R3）

ILM hart-local base = `0x0`、DLM = `0x200000`，這兩個**都落在 DRAM(0x0-2GB)範圍內**。milmb/mdlmb enable 時它們 overlay 在 DRAM 上。所以 linker script 要把 TCM section 精準放到這些位址，且 DRAM 主程式不能佔用那些位址。這是 F4 fixture 最花工的部分。

**建議分兩步做 F4**：
- **F4a（先）**：只測 DLM data（verify code 跑在 DRAM，不從 ILM 抓指令）- linker 只要放 DLM 一塊，簡單很多，就能決定性證明 content transport。
- **F4b（後）**：再加 ILM code 執行（要處理 fetch-from-TCM 的 overlay），補齊 ILM 覆蓋。

content.text:
可以 - ILM 用同一套 shape（runtime 填內容 -> handoff -> ROI 使用 -> checksum），但差別是 ILM 裝的是 **code**，而且剛剛的驗證推翻了我上一輪的一個說法，先更正。

## 更正：static 初始化其實「兩邊都不能用」，runtime 填是必要的

上一輪我說「static array 就能測」- **錯**。剛讀到決定性證據（`cpu.c:673-681`）：

- ILM/DLM overlay 是掛在 **per-CPU address space**（`env->cpu_as_root`），不是 system memory。
- QEMU 的 ELF loader 寫的是 **system memory**（DRAM）。
- 所以 driver 路徑下（`default_enable=on`，overlay 開機就在）：loader 把 static 內容寫進 DRAM，但 hart 讀那個位址時 overlay 攔走 -> 讀到 **TCM 的零**，不是 loader 寫的 bytes。

結論：static-init 的 TCM section 在 **QEMU 階段就拿不到值**（跟 vsim 無關）。ILM 和 DLM 都必須由**程式自己在 runtime 寫進去**。這正好就是真硬體的做法（crt0/程式把 code 從 flash/DRAM copy 進 TCM），所以 test 反而更貼近真實。

## ILM 測試 sketch

```c
// 一小段自包含的 kernel，先以「資料」形式存在 DRAM
static const uint32_t blob[] = { /* 組好的 asm routine: a0 = f(a0) */ };

int main(void) {
  // ---- QEMU 階段：把 code 塞進 ILM（hart-local view）----
  volatile uint32_t *ilm = (uint32_t *)0x100;        // ILM base 0x0 + offset, 避開 null
  for (i...) ilm[i] = blob[i];
  asm volatile("fence.i");                           // 寫完 code 必須 fence.i

  uint32_t (*fn)(uint32_t) = (void *)(uintptr_t)0x100;

  andesim_ROI_begin();                               // ---- handoff -> vsim ----
  uint32_t r = fn(0x12345678);                       // 從 ILM RTL fetch 執行
  andesim_ROI_end();
  return r == EXPECTED ? 0 : 1;
}
```

跟 DLM 版一樣的判定鏈：ELF 裡沒有 ILM 內容（blob 在 DRAM，ILM 是 runtime 寫的）-> vsim 看得到的唯一途徑是 handoff（plugin drain 0xA0000000 -> `.ilm` sidecar -> `set_ilm`）。

## ILM 特有的四個點

| 點 | 說明 |
|----|------|
| **失敗更大聲** | ILM 沒搬到 = 全零 = RISC-V 定義的 illegal instruction -> ROI 內直接 trap，不只是 checksum 錯 |
| **code 要自包含** | copy 過去的 routine 不能有指向 DRAM 的 relocation。最穩：手寫幾條 asm 組成 blob（比 copy C function 的 bytes 可靠） |
| **fence.i** | runtime 寫 code 後、執行前必要（icache/翻譯一致性） |
| **避開 0x0** | ILM hart-local base 是 0x0 = C 的 null。function 放 base+0x100，用 uintptr 轉 pointer |

vsim 端不用任何新東西：RTL reset 時 ILM 就是 enabled、base 0x0（CLAUDE.md：vsim drains milmb EN=1），跟 QEMU cfg 側一致 - **content 是唯一缺口**，測的就是它。

## 一個 F4 要查的 checklist 項

fixture 都 link 在 `0x100000`（剛 readelf 確認）。ILM 範圍 0x0..0xFFFF 沒衝突；但 **DLM 0x200000 只在 link base 上方 1MB** - C fixture 的 image + heap 若超過 1MB 就撞進 DLM overlay。F4 要 assert image end < 0x200000（或挪 link base）。

要我把這些（runtime-populate 是必要非可選 + ILM asm-blob 測法 + 0x200000 collision check + F4a/F4b 拆分）一次更新進 ROADMAP F4 嗎？

# ROADMAP: ILM/DLM content transport across the hybrid handoff (Approach A)

Goal: make Hart 0 ILM (`0xA0000000..0xA01FFFFF`) and DLM (`0xA0200000..0xA03FFFFF`)
memory CONTENT survive the QEMU1 -> vsim handoff, so a benchmark whose hot
code/data lives in TCM measures correct results and correct cycles.

Scope: content only. The config CSRs (`milmb`/`mdlmb`) are already transported in
the v3 Andes block (verify-excluded). This roadmap is about the bytes.

## Why this matters
ILM/DLM are TCM (tightly-coupled memory) = single-cycle local RAM, the most
performance-relevant memory in the AE350. Today the content is NOT transported
(3 gaps: not in the shared mmap, plugin does not drain it, vsim `load_elf` only
targets main_memory). vsim resumes with ILM/DLM at RTL reset (empty). Latent
today (no fixture uses TCM); breaks/mis-measures any TCM benchmark.

## Chosen approach: A (file sidecar + reuse `--ilm`/`--dlm`)
Plugin drains ILM/DLM to sidecar files next to the state `--outfile`; the driver
feeds them to the vsim leg via the EXISTING `--ilm`/`--dlm` args; vsim's existing
`load_image` backdoor writes them into the RTL.

Key reason A wins: the vsim restore leg already exists and is nearly free.
- `--ilm`/`--dlm` -> `Simulator::load_image` (`vsim: src/simulator.hpp:524`)
  -> `cpu.set_ilm`/`set_dlm`
  (`vsim: src/cpu_wrappers/ax45mpv_premium_cpu_cluster_subsystem.hpp:392,466`).
- `set_ilm` is NOT a bus/PB/DMI transfer. It is a Verilator hierarchical-reference
  poke straight into the model SRAM array (`rootp->..__DOT__..mem[i] = word`),
  costs zero sim cycles, and regenerates ECC/parity itself. So the plugin only
  needs to drain RAW data; vsim rebuilds ECC.
- No ABI change: content rides sidecar files, `hybrid_state_v1` is untouched.

Alternatives (not chosen now): B shared-mmap-backed ILM/DLM (less invasive per
run but changes mmap layout on both sides + QEMU device model); C add an ABI
block (96KB into the state file, larger ABI surface). Revisit only if A hits a
wall.

## Established facts (verified in code; trust these, do not re-derive)
- QEMU slave port: `subport_create` (`qemu: hw/riscv/andes_ae350.c:1381`) maps
  `0xA0000000`/`0xA0200000` as `memory_region_init_io` with `subport_ops`, which
  dispatch to the hart-local `env->mask_ilm`/`env->mask_dlm`
  (`qemu: target/riscv/cpu_helper.c:1308-1330`). So the slave port aliases the
  real ILM/DLM content.
- TCM overlay is PER-CPU, not system memory: `andes_cpu_lm_realize`
  (`qemu: target/riscv/cpu.c:673-696`) does `memory_region_init_ram` then
  `memory_region_add_subregion_overlap(env->cpu_as_root, ...)` - the overlay
  exists only in the CPU's address space, and only when `*_default_enable` is on
  (dynamic enable via a guest `milmb` write is handled around
  `qemu: target/riscv/andes_csr.c:1270`; F0 confirms that path in practice).
- CONSEQUENCE - runtime-populate is REQUIRED, static-init is dead on arrival:
  QEMU's ELF loader writes SYSTEM memory (DRAM). A static-initialized section
  with a TCM VMA lands in DRAM; a hart with the overlay enabled then reads the
  TCM (zeros) at that address, never the loaded bytes. So for BOTH ILM and DLM
  the fixture itself must write the content at runtime (which is also how real
  silicon TCM is populated - crt0/program copies it in). This kills any
  "linker-places-static-sections-into-TCM" fixture design.
- Sizes are configurable, NOT fixed. QEMU builds the actual RAM at the property
  size: `qemu.cfg ilm_size` -> SoC prop -> `env->ilm_size`
  (`qemu: target/riscv/cpu.c:640,643`) -> `memory_region_init_ram(env->mask_ilm,
  env->ilm_size)` (`cpu.c:673`). `ax45mpv_premium` = ILM 64KB / DLM 32KB via the
  `--print-qemu-config` -> `-readconfig qemu.cfg` path (`ilm_size=65536`,
  `dlm_size=32768`, `*_default_enable=on`). QEMU compiled-in defaults are 2MB/2MB
  + enable=off (the raw path plugin tests use). Only the slave-port ADDRESS
  window is fixed (2MB in the memmap); just the first `ilm_size` bytes are
  RAM-backed. Valid size 0 or pow2 in [1KB, 512MB].
- Hart-local TCM ranges on the premium engine: ILM `0x0..0xFFFF` (64KB),
  DLM `0x200000..0x207FFF` (32KB). Fixtures link at `0x100000` (readelf
  verified: entry + PT_LOAD paddr 0x100000) -> ILM range is free; DLM range sits
  only 1MB above the link base, so a big image could collide (see R3).
- vsim RTL resets with ILM/DLM ENABLED at those bases (CLAUDE.md: vsim drains
  `milmb.EN=1`; `NDS_ILM_BASE=0x0`, `NDS_DLM_BASE=0x200000`). With the driver
  cfg path QEMU also boots enabled -> both sides enabled, bases match, CONTENT
  is the only missing piece.
- Plugin drains exactly one region today (L2C, `qemu_plugin: hybrid_handoff.c:444`
  `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr`). Pattern to copy.
- vsim `load_image` order: `main.cpp:446` (before `sc_start` 453, before
  `sim.reset()` 529, before `apply_resume_from_qemu` 563).

## Risks
- R1 (was the gate, now RESOLVED by code read): can the plugin read the subport IO
  region? YES. `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr` (`qemu: plugins/api.c:499-536`)
  uses `address_space_rw`, which DOES dispatch to IO region read callbacks - not
  only RAM like L2C. The subport callback forwards to `env->mask_ilm`/`mask_dlm`
  (`qemu: cpu_helper.c:1308-1311`). The L2C drain already proves the plugin's CPU
  address space reaches system-memory regions, and `0xA0000000` sits in the same
  system memory. So F0 is a quick confirmation, not a gate; F0b (QEMU change) is
  almost certainly unneeded.
- R2: does `sim.reset()` preserve backdoor-loaded SRAM? (F2)
- R3: hart-local collisions. ILM base is `0x0` (also C NULL - place the test
  routine at base+0x100, cast via uintptr) and DLM `0x200000` is 1MB above the
  fixture link base `0x100000` - the e2e fixtures must assert image end <
  `0x200000` (or move the link base). Drain ALWAYS via the slave-port aperture
  `0xA0000000`, never hart-local `0x0`.
- R4: single hart only (hart0), matching current hybrid scope.

## Features (TDD: each starts with a failing test; one feature per session)

Repos: `andesim` (driver, plugin, fixtures, tests), `vsim` = /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim,
`qemu` = /home/nick/work/qemu_andesim.

| ID | Name | State |
|----|------|-------|
| F0 | Confirm the plugin can read the subport IO region (quick check) | TODO |
| F1 | Plugin drains ILM/DLM content to sidecar files | TODO |
| F2 | vsim resume-time LM load is correct + survives reset | TODO |
| F3 | Driver wires drained LM files into the vsim leg | TODO |
| F4a | E2E: DLM data round-trip (runtime-filled buffer + checksum) | TODO |
| F4b | E2E: ILM code round-trip (asm blob executed from TCM) | TODO |
| F5 | (stretch) --verify LM content round-trip | TODO |

### F0 - Confirm the plugin can read the subport IO region (quick check)
- Expected PASS (see R1): `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr` uses `address_space_rw`,
  which handles IO regions. This just confirms it before building F1 on top.
- Test: `tests/plugin/test_plugin_lm_drain.sh` + fixture that sets `milmb.EN=1`
  (the raw-QEMU plugin-test path boots with `*_default_enable=off` and 2MB
  sizes - no `-readconfig`), runtime-writes a known pattern at hart-local ILM,
  hits the marker; assert the plugin read the pattern back from the SLAVE-PORT
  base `0xA0000000`. This confirms three things at once: dynamic overlay map on
  the `milmb` write, slave-port aliasing, and the IO-region drain.
- If it unexpectedly fails/returns 0: add F0b = QEMU change to expose the subport

- May be folded into F1's first test rather than run as a separate step.

# ROADMAP: ILM/DLM content transport across the hybrid handoff (Approach A)

Goal: make Hart 0 ILM (`0xA0000000..0xA01FFFFF`) and DLM (`0xA0200000..0xA03FFFFF`)
memory CONTENT survive the QEMU1 -> vsim handoff, so a benchmark whose hot
code/data lives in TCM measures correct results and correct cycles.

Scope: content only. The config CSRs (`milmb`/`mdlmb`) are already transported in
the v3 Andes block (verify-excluded). This roadmap is about the bytes.

## Why this matters
ILM/DLM are TCM (tightly-coupled memory) = single-cycle local RAM, the most
performance-relevant memory in the AE350. Today the content is NOT transported
(3 gaps: not in the shared mmap, plugin does not drain it, vsim `load_elf` only
targets main_memory). vsim resumes with ILM/DLM at RTL reset (empty). Latent
today (no fixture uses TCM); breaks/mis-measures any TCM benchmark.

## Chosen approach: A (file sidecar + reuse `--ilm`/`--dlm`)
Plugin drains ILM/DLM to sidecar files next to the state `--outfile`; the driver
feeds them to the vsim leg via the EXISTING `--ilm`/`--dlm` args; vsim's existing
`load_image` backdoor writes them into the RTL.

Key reason A wins: the vsim restore leg already exists and is nearly free.
- `--ilm`/`--dlm` -> `Simulator::load_image` (`vsim: src/simulator.hpp:524`)
  -> `cpu.set_ilm`/`set_dlm`
  (`vsim: src/cpu_wrappers/ax45mpv_premium_cpu_cluster_subsystem.hpp:392,466`).
- `set_ilm` is NOT a bus/PB/DMI transfer. It is a Verilator hierarchical-reference
  poke straight into the model SRAM array (`rootp->..__DOT__..mem[i] = word`),
  costs zero sim cycles, and regenerates ECC/parity itself. So the plugin only
  needs to drain RAW data; vsim rebuilds ECC.
- No ABI change: content rides sidecar files, `hybrid_state_v1` is untouched.

Alternatives (not chosen now): B shared-mmap-backed ILM/DLM (less invasive per
run but changes mmap layout on both sides + QEMU device model); C add an ABI
block (96KB into the state file, larger ABI surface). Revisit only if A hits a
wall.

## Established facts (verified in code; trust these, do not re-derive)
- QEMU slave port: `subport_create` (`qemu: hw/riscv/andes_ae350.c:1381`) maps
  `0xA0000000`/`0xA0200000` as `memory_region_init_io` with `subport_ops`, which
  dispatch to the hart-local `env->mask_ilm`/`env->mask_dlm`
  (`qemu: target/riscv/cpu_helper.c:1308-1330`). So the slave port aliases the
  real ILM/DLM content.
- TCM overlay is PER-CPU, not system memory: `andes_cpu_lm_realize`
  (`qemu: target/riscv/cpu.c:673-696`) does `memory_region_init_ram` then
  `memory_region_add_subregion_overlap(env->cpu_as_root, ...)` - the overlay
  exists only in the CPU's address space, and only when `*_default_enable` is on
  (dynamic enable via a guest `milmb` write is handled around
  `qemu: target/riscv/andes_csr.c:1270`; F0 confirms that path in practice).
- CONSEQUENCE - runtime-populate is REQUIRED, static-init is dead on arrival:
  QEMU's ELF loader writes SYSTEM memory (DRAM). A static-initialized section
  with a TCM VMA lands in DRAM; a hart with the overlay enabled then reads the
  TCM (zeros) at that address, never the loaded bytes. So for BOTH ILM and DLM
  the fixture itself must write the content at runtime (which is also how real
  silicon TCM is populated - crt0/program copies it in). This kills any
  "linker-places-static-sections-into-TCM" fixture design.
- Sizes are configurable, NOT fixed. QEMU builds the actual RAM at the property
  size: `qemu.cfg ilm_size` -> SoC prop -> `env->ilm_size`
  (`qemu: target/riscv/cpu.c:640,643`) -> `memory_region_init_ram(env->mask_ilm,
  env->ilm_size)` (`cpu.c:673`). `ax45mpv_premium` = ILM 64KB / DLM 32KB via the
  `--print-qemu-config` -> `-readconfig qemu.cfg` path (`ilm_size=65536`,
  `dlm_size=32768`, `*_default_enable=on`). QEMU compiled-in defaults are 2MB/2MB
  + enable=off (the raw path plugin tests use). Only the slave-port ADDRESS
  window is fixed (2MB in the memmap); just the first `ilm_size` bytes are
  RAM-backed. Valid size 0 or pow2 in [1KB, 512MB].
- Hart-local TCM ranges on the premium engine: ILM `0x0..0xFFFF` (64KB),
  DLM `0x200000..0x207FFF` (32KB). Fixtures link at `0x100000` (readelf
  verified: entry + PT_LOAD paddr 0x100000) -> ILM range is free; DLM range sits
  only 1MB above the link base, so a big image could collide (see R3).
- vsim RTL resets with ILM/DLM ENABLED at those bases (CLAUDE.md: vsim drains
  `milmb.EN=1`; `NDS_ILM_BASE=0x0`, `NDS_DLM_BASE=0x200000`). With the driver
  cfg path QEMU also boots enabled -> both sides enabled, bases match, CONTENT
  is the only missing piece.
- Plugin drains exactly one region today (L2C, `qemu_plugin: hybrid_handoff.c:444`
  `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr`). Pattern to copy.
- vsim `load_image` order: `main.cpp:446` (before `sc_start` 453, before
  `sim.reset()` 529, before `apply_resume_from_qemu` 563).

  region? YES. `qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr` (`qemu: plugins/api.c:499-536`)
  uses `address_space_rw`, which DOES dispatch to IO region read callbacks - not
  only RAM like L2C. The subport callback forwards to `env->mask_ilm`/`mask_dlm`

  address space reaches system-memory regions, and `0xA0000000` sits in the same

- R4: single hart only (hart0), matching current hybrid scope.
